name: Kouyama Kumi
source:
A housewife who lives next door to the Toyooka family. She has a family of three with a husband on a long-term business trip and a son.

She is the one who invited Mie to join the Mama's Club. She says she felt the same thing in Mie as herself, and supports her actions.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mmc3.html]official site[/url]]
